features.title: Automated Onboarding Portals
features.body: Give subcontractors a dedicated portal where they upload documentation, sign work orders, and view project timelines. Track GST certificates, insurance, and trade licences through each onboarding phase.

data.title: Subcontractor Portal: Rajesh Construction Pvt Ltd

features.title: Real-Time Compliance Verification
features.body: Track certificate of insurance policy dates and automatically flag non-compliant vendors before they reach site. A live feed shows verification events as they happen.

personas.title: Compliance Officers
personas.body: Keep every vendor's insurance and licences current without manual follow-ups.

personas.title: Project Managers
personas.body: Run RA billing and track subcontractor attendance and progress in one view.

faqs.q: How does SiteFlow verify insurance documents?
faqs.a: Policy validity, coverage limits, and expiry dates are tracked against the vendor record, and non-compliant vendors are flagged before they reach site.

faqs.q: Can we track daily attendance per sub-contractor?
faqs.a: Yes, the mobile app supports geo-fenced check-ins and QR-code entry logs that feed into your workforce reporting dashboard.

faqs.q: Does the platform support retention payments?
faqs.a: Yes. SiteFlow calculates retention from your contract terms and flags release only when compliance and quality gates are met.

cta.heading: Ready to streamline your subcontractor workflows?
cta.body: Onboard, comply, and bill subcontractors from one workspace with SiteFlow.
